purpose: Single machine-readable source of truth for the final automatic priority_rank after all visual enrichment and refinement are complete.

precedence.rule: This contract is authoritative for final priority_rank. Any older sorting arrays in config/mailing_policy.json are legacy documentation and must not be used by production ranking code.

sale_expiry_urgency_asc.reason: Prevent the user from missing a still-relevant deal before it expires.

practical_or_personal_risk_asc.reason: Confirmed serious personal experience conflicts or modern-Windows friction must be considered before the mixed taste/deal bucket, so a commercially attractive cheap deal cannot outrank a safer candidate merely because its purchase verdict is better.

priority_bucket_asc.reason: After urgency and serious confirmed risk, preserve the qualitative taste/deal matrix as the main combined quality layer.

wishlist_desc.reason: Wishlist is a meaningful but bounded explicit-interest signal after eligibility, major risks, and the qualitative taste/deal bucket.

discount_percent_desc.reason: Discount size precedes historical-minimum quality because a new game's routine first discount may automatically be its record due only to short price history.

price_quality_vs_history_desc.reason: Historical quality remains useful context after the current discount strength is considered.

current_price_rub_asc.reason: Prefer cheaper otherwise equivalent purchases inside the already enforced budget rules.

achievement_quality_desc.reason: Achievements are important mainly for close candidates and must not outrank materially better commercial value.

duration_tiebreak_asc.reason: Duration is only a very late weak preference tiebreaker.

direct_user_evidence.reason: Direct user evidence already adjusts fit and therefore priority_bucket upstream; sorting by it again would double-count taste.

ui_override.reason: An explicit user queue decision overrides every automatic priority, including a deal expiring today.
